newsitem.title: USA: USDA pegs planted cotton acreage at 13.2-14.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: USDA pegs planted cotton acreage at 13.2-14.2 mln.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said total U.S. cotton area will range between 13.2 million and 14.2 million acres in 1997/97.
Planted area in 1996/97 totaled 14.2 million acres.

"While this may seem at first like a wide range, the flexibility provisions of the new farm legislation allow decisions to be altered right up to planting time," Stephen MacDonald, an agricultural economist with USDA, said.
But lower abandonment could keep harvested acreage close to current levels, he told industry members at the National Cotton Council annual Beltwide Cotton Conference.
USDA pegged yields per harvested acre at 660 lbs to 680 lbs in 1997/98, compared with 709 pounds this season.
